spec_features.spec_quote: the instructions explicitly tell the agent to run tests and keep going until they pass or the task is "confirmed impossible."
spec_features.evidence: agent/driver.py:34-47 defines _GIVE_UP_PATTERNS and _has_given_up(); driver.py:116-120 'if _has_given_up(turn.assistant_text) and not turn.tool_calls:' sets gave_up=True and break, so the loop actually stops when the agent declares impossibility. The instruction text is delivered in agent/prompts.py ('Keep going until all tests pass or you are confident the task cannot be completed') and tasks/base.py:46-49. It is real, enforced enforcement, but narrowed: it ONLY fires on regex-matched give-up phrasing AND only when there are no tool calls; there is no dedicated exit/finish tool the agent can call.
spec_features.notes: Exit is heuristic text-pattern based, not a tool the subject can deliberately invoke; if give-up text co-occurs with any tool call it is ignored and the loop continues.

spec_features.spec_quote: the loop runs for a maximum of `max_turns` (default 30)
spec_features.evidence: agent/driver.py:65 self.max_turns = task.max_turns or EXPERIMENT.default_max_turns; driver.py:91 'for turn_num in range(self.max_turns):' bounds the loop. config.py:91 default_max_turns: int = 30; tasks/base.py:31 max_turns: int = 30. The range() bound actually terminates the loop.
spec_features.notes: Cap is read and enforced by the loop bound.

spec_features.spec_quote: the loop terminates on three conditions — give-up, empty response, or turn cap
spec_features.evidence: All three are wired in agent/driver.py: give-up break at lines 117-120 (sets gave_up and break); empty-response break at lines 123-125 ('if not turn.tool_calls and not turn.assistant_text.strip(): ... break'); turn cap via the 'for turn_num in range(self.max_turns)' loop bound at line 91. (A 4th exception/crash break exists at line 96-99.)
spec_features.notes: All three conditions execute and break/exit the loop.
spec_features.code_justification_quote: # If no tool calls and no meaningful text, the agent is done.
